QuestInfo.name: The Zealots' Appointment Ceremony
QuestInfo.0:
Talk to #bLaiyan#k, Captain of the Zealous, and attend the Zealots' appointment ceremony.
You'll have to wear #b#t1053943##k and #b#t1073717##k to attend.
QuestInfo.1:
Attend the Zealots' appointment ceremony.

#r* If you leave during the quest, forfeit the quest and accept it again.
QuestInfo.2: You were bestowed the honor of becoming a Zealot along with Rasha. In addition, the esteemed lord remembered you well.
